scope: Existing twenty-four EX045 formal accounts only. Frozen model schedules reconstructed into candidate runtime identity; independent scalar predictions from authenticated EX036 features, not mutable signal CSVs. No prepare/evaluate calls.
entry_cycle_semantics: Binary intentions, locked requested cycle quantity; retry possible until intention closes. Actual holding lengths are measured, not asserted equal to hold. Open ending cycles marked at last close, never forced sold.
diagnostic_limits: Gross profit is fixed realized fill cash flow plus terminal position mark before actual fees, not a rerun with zero fees. Entry-day/later split is ledger attribution, not avoidable loss or causal identification.
technical_precheck: Runner reports first-configuration serial/parallel two-window five-ledger equality; two technical repeat scenarios excluded from 24 formal accounts. This audit independently checks formal evidence and does not rerun those technical scenarios.
permission_exit_semantics: Closed cycle duration plus entry delay equals preceding intent age plus market-sell delay; preceding intent age never exceeds cap. Every pre-cap exit has false current permission.
